newsitem.title: PERU: Peru's January cement output rises 10.9 percent.
newsitem.headline: Peru's January cement output rises 10.9 percent.

text.p: Peru's January cement output rose 10.9 percent to 341,735 tonnes compared with the same month last year, the private Association of Cement Producers (ASOCEM) said Thursday.
In January 1995, the country's cement production reached 308,143 tonnes, the ASOCEM report said.
Peru produced 3.848 million tonnes of cement in 1996.
The biggest cement producer in January was Cementos Lima with 153,641 tonnes, followed by Cementos Norte Pacasmayo with 71,770 tonnes.
Cementos Lima saw output rise 13.57 percent over January 1995, while Cementos Norte Pacasmayo posted a 10.3-percent hike over the same month last year.
The firms also were ranked the No. 1 and No. 2 producers last year.
